repo_notes.content: Always use the latest files in the repo to generate the wiki

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce BetterLyrics, its purpose as a WinUI3 lyrics display application, key features, and supported music players

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Guide users through installation, initial setup, and basic usage of BetterLyrics

pages.title: Installation and Deployment
pages.purpose: Explain how to install BetterLyrics from Microsoft Store or build from source, system requirements, and supported Windows versions

pages.title: Initial Configuration
pages.purpose: Walk through first-time setup including media player configuration, folder selection, and basic settings

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: Provide technical overview of BetterLyrics' internal architecture, design patterns, and component organization

pages.title: Application Entry Point and Dependency Injection
pages.purpose: Document the App.xaml.cs entry point, service registration, and dependency injection container configuration

pages.title: Service Layer Architecture
pages.purpose: Explain the service-oriented architecture, service interfaces, and their implementations including MediaSessionsService, LyricsSearchService, and SettingsService

pages.title: Data Models
pages.purpose: Document core data models including LyricsLine, LyricsData, SongInfo, and configuration models

pages.title: Multi-Window System
pages.purpose: Explain how BetterLyrics manages multiple simultaneous lyrics windows, window lifecycle, and state management

pages.title: User Interface
pages.purpose: Document the UI components, windows, and user interaction patterns in BetterLyrics

pages.title: Now Playing Window
pages.purpose: Detail the main lyrics display window, its components, and integration with the rendering system

pages.title: Display Modes and Window Configurations
pages.purpose: Explain different display modes (Standard, Desktop, Docked, Fullscreen, Narrow, Taskbar) and how to configure them

pages.title: Settings and Customization
pages.purpose: Document the settings interface, configuration options, and how to customize lyrics appearance and behavior

pages.title: Music Gallery
pages.purpose: Explain the local music library management feature, including playback, playlist management, and integration with media controls

pages.title: System Tray and Global Controls
pages.purpose: Document the system tray integration, global hotkeys, and application-wide controls

pages.title: Lyrics System
pages.purpose: Comprehensive documentation of the lyrics acquisition, processing, and display pipeline

pages.title: Lyrics Search and Providers
pages.purpose: Document the lyrics search system, supported providers (QQ Music, Netease, Kugou, LrcLib, Apple Music, local files), and search strategies

pages.title: Parsing and Translation
pages.purpose: Explain how lyrics are parsed from different formats (LRC, QRC, TTML), translation system using LibreTranslate, and metadata matching

pages.title: Rendering Pipeline
pages.purpose: Document the Win2D-based rendering system, LyricsCanvas, PlayingLineRenderer, UnplayingLineRenderer, and LyricsLayoutManager

pages.title: Visual Effects and Animation
pages.purpose: Explain character-level effects (glow, float, scale), background effects (fluid, snow, fog, spectrum), and the animation transition system

pages.title: Media Integration
pages.purpose: Document how BetterLyrics integrates with music players and manages media sessions

pages.title: Windows Media Transport Controls Integration
pages.purpose: Explain how BetterLyrics uses Windows SMTC to work universally with media players

pages.title: Supported Players and Special Configurations
pages.purpose: List supported media players, document special configurations (Apple Music token, LX Music SSE), and player-specific handling

pages.title: Album Art and Theme Colors
pages.purpose: Document album art retrieval from multiple sources, color palette generation (MedianCut, OctTree), and adaptive theming

pages.title: Internationalization
pages.purpose: Explain the localization system, supported languages, and how resources are managed

pages.title: Development
pages.purpose: Technical documentation for developers contributing to or extending BetterLyrics

pages.title: Build Configuration and Deployment
pages.purpose: Document the build process, publish profiles for different architectures, CI/CD pipeline, and packaging for Microsoft Store

pages.title: Helper Utilities and Extensions
pages.purpose: Document utility classes including TaskbarHook, WindowHook, ColorHelper, ImageHelper, and various extension methods

pages.title: External Dependencies and Libraries
pages.purpose: List and explain third-party dependencies including Win2D, NAudio, ATL.NET, FlaUI, and their usage in the application
